documentation: The version of each documented package that its public repository last published, which is what the documentation displays and what the Cinder token runtime stamps (COR-231). Updated by hand after each batch backport, from `npm view <package> version`; when Cinder's entry changes, `src/cinder-published-bases.json` needs that version's base digest too. The mirror tooling that used to record these now lives in stevekinney/corvidae-mirror and does not write here. This file belongs to the playground workspace, so a change to it rebuilds cinder.website like any other source change.
